stop_conditions: Stop on any per-action position tracking error exceeding 10 mm or attitude tracking error exceeding 0.10 rad.
Stop for observed slip, unexpected card rotation, visible misalignment, target mismatch, interference or deformation.
If observable contact or blocked progress occurs before the endpoint, stop rather than attempting to overcome it; do not assume the tracking guard detects every contact.
Do not exceed either 64-action segment at 15 Hz or continue after a guard stop.
End at the specified final waypoint and settling phase, or earlier on a stop condition; retain the grasp and request independent review.
